estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands opening a shallow furrow about 2 cm deep in loose, stone-free soil of a vegetable bed
Close-up of a man's hands sprinkling tiny carrot seeds sparsely along a shallow furrow; the small mascot figurine sits on the wooden edge of the raised bed next to the furrow
Close-up of a man's hands thinning a row of young carrot seedlings with feathery leaves, leaving gaps between the plants
Radish plants pulled from the soil with large lush leaves and very thin, undeveloped roots, lying on a sunny vegetable bed
Beetroot plants with red-veined leaves, the purple shoulders of the roots showing above the soil
Sweet potato vines with heart-shaped leaves spreading over a garden bed; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil between the vines
Row of onion plants with round bulbs half showing in the soil of a sunny bed
Row of young garlic plants with narrow upright leaves in rich soil under full sun
